verdict.rationale: An llms.txt file or agent-oriented docs is a fair thing for a SaaS note-taking app to publish, so the axis applies, but the probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404) and the evidence never mentions agent-oriented documentation. The OpenAPI spec published on openpm is a general machine-readable API reference for a different story (an API spec), not documentation aimed at agents, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
